title: 1428 Brickell
description: Luxury residences in Brickell Miami featuring private elevators, panoramic views and world-class amenities.
features:
Overview

Viceroy Brickell Residences represents a new generation of branded luxury living in Miami. Developed by Related Group and GTIS Partners, the tower combines contemporary architecture by Arquitectonica with interiors by Meyer Davis and the legendary hospitality of Viceroy Hotels & Resorts.

Positioned where the Miami River meets Brickell, the residences offer panoramic city and waterfront views while providing immediate access to Brickell City Centre, Downtown Miami, Coconut Grove, Key Biscayne, and Miami International Airport.

Residents enjoy an elevated lifestyle focused on wellness, design, personalized services, and world-class amenities, making Viceroy one of the most desirable residential addresses in Brickell.

title: Cipriani Residences Miami
description: Luxury waterfront residences in Brickell Miami.
features:
Cipriani Residences Miami brings the legendary Italian hospitality brand to the center of Brickell.

Designed by Arquitectonica with interiors by 1508 London, the tower rises above Miami’s financial district offering expansive residences with sweeping views of Biscayne Bay, Simpson Park, and the Brickell skyline.

Inspired by nearly a century of Cipriani heritage, every residence reflects timeless design, elevated service, and effortless luxury.

Residents enjoy signature Cipriani hospitality, private dining experiences, wellness amenities, resort-style pools, and personalized concierge services.

Highlights:

Architecture by Arquitectonica
Interiors by 1508 London
Signature Cipriani services
Resort-style amenities
Panoramic Bay and Skyline views
Private dining experiences
Prime Brickell location

St. Regis Residences Miami

Located directly on Biscayne Bay in the heart of Brickell, St. Regis Residences Miami redefines luxury waterfront living through timeless design, expansive residences, and legendary St. Regis hospitality.

Created as a design-driven residential collection, the project combines refined architecture, private residential amenities, curated services, and panoramic water views to deliver one of Miami's most prestigious residential addresses.

title: Villa Miami
description: Bayfront residences in Edgewater, Miami, conceived around the Major Food Group residential experience.
features:
Overview

Villa Miami is a bayfront residential experience in Edgewater, conceived around the lifestyle and hospitality of Major Food Group. The tower brings dining, wellness, service, and waterfront living into one residential setting on Biscayne Bay.

Architecture by ODP Architects is paired with interiors by Vicky Charles of Charles & Co and landscape design by Enea Garden Co. The residential experience connects life between land, water, and air, with docks at the bay and a rooftop helipad above the tower.

Residences occupy levels 6 through 52, with full-floor Villa Piano and half-floor Villa Mezzo collections. Penthouses are positioned across levels 53 through 55. The condominium is developed by 710 Edge Property, LLC; Terra and One Thousand Group are associated development teams, while Major Food Group provides the residential lifestyle and branding under license.

title: The Perigon
description: Oceanfront residences by OMA on the shores of Miami Beach.
features:
Overview

The Perigon is a private oceanfront enclave on Miami Beach, bringing 73 residences to a setting between the Atlantic Ocean and Biscayne Bay. Its cascading form is designed to draw water views and natural light into each home while preserving privacy across both horizons.

Architecture by OMA — Office for Metropolitan Architecture — is joined by interiors from Tara Bernerd & Partners and landscape design by Gustafson Porter + Bowman. Together, the design teams frame a residential experience shaped by Miami Beach's light, water, and coastal landscape.

The amenity program extends from the beach to dining, wellness, and entertaining spaces, including a residents-only oceanfront restaurant and speakeasy. Official occupancy is anticipated in Q2 2027.

title: NoMad Residences Wynwood
description: NoMad Residences Wynwood, a furnished residential collection at 2700 NW 2nd Avenue in Miami.
amenities: Rooftop pool, sun deck, and cabanas
features:
Overview

NoMad Residences Wynwood brings the first residential expression of the NoMad brand to Miami's creative district. Located at 2700 NW 2nd Avenue, the nine-story collection places art, hospitality, and flexible ownership at the center of Wynwood.

The building is developed by PRH G40 Property Owner, LLC and designed by Arquitectonica, with interiors by DesignAgency. Its 329 residences are fully furnished and curated by NoMad and DesignAgency, with layouts ranging from studios to two-bedroom homes.

Across the building, food, wellness, social spaces, and services support a residential experience shaped for everyday life and short-term rental flexibility without rental restrictions.
